policy.intent: Mirror the local research environment into VELA except explicitly excluded areas.
include: literature acquisition and citation evidence workflows
writing, review, figure, presentation, submission, and quantitative workflows
validators, envctl modules, scripts, schemas, and tests
exclude: distilled scholar generation and scholar advisory panel chain
browser login state, cookies, credentials, and personal secrets
private absolute paths; exported settings use placeholders

layout.runtime_mode: snapshot; not automatically executed by VELA init
layout.settings_policy: settings.toml is scrubbed to portable placeholders
